From Acme: "Delivery lead time: 14 business days from purchase order". BrightPath: "Delivery lead time: 21 calendar days from purchase order". Orbital: "lead_time: 10 business days". Nimbus: "Delivery lead time 7 business days".

Thus fastest is Nimbus with 7 business days. Need to output line "Fastest delivery: Nimbus Tech Supply" or vendor name. The vendor name is Nimbus Tech Supply. So final answer: "Fastest delivery: Nimbus Tech Supply".
